svg.aria-label: How often each submitted top-10 player stays in the top 10 when the data is re-sampled
svg.title: How often each submitted top-10 player stays in the top 10 when the data is re-sampled
svg.desc: Horizontal bars for the ten batters and ten bowlers: the share of 1,000 bootstrap runs and of 1,000 pool-deletion runs in which the player is still in the top 10, with the fragility label from the bootstrap share.
svg.text: Share of 1,000 re-rating runs in which the submitted top-10 player is still in the top 10.
Bootstrap: matches resampled, so a player's own results vary
Pool deletion: a random 20% of the other eligible players removed
